# 🏦 Bank Management System

## 📌 About
Bank Management System developed using Python and MySQL.

## 🚀 Features
- Create Account
- Deposit Amount
- Withdraw Amount
- Check Balance
- Money Transfer
- Delete Account
- View All Accounts

## 🛠 Technologies Used
- Python
- MySQL
- PDBC

## ▶ How to Run

Install requirements:

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

Run project:

```bash
python BANKBD.py
```
